recommended_actions.title: Plan certificate algorithm and trust-store migration
recommended_actions.rationale: PKI updates require coordinated CA, chain, and relying-party compatibility planning. FIPS 204/205 standardize signature primitives, not a universal hybrid certificate format.
steps: Inventory certificate signature algorithms and key sizes from CBOM/report output.
Identify the exact certificate construction and encoding, then verify provider, CA, client and trust-store support before planning issuance.
Pilot only a supported construction in non-production trust stores; if format or ecosystem support is unavailable, keep issuance unverified and evaluate another supported migration path.
Define reissuance plan for quantum-vulnerable roots/intermediates/end-entity certs.
